Node.js Versions: Latest Releases & EOL Dates (Nov 2026) (https://www.herodevs.com/blog-posts/node-js-end-of-life-dates-you-should-be-aware-of)
Node.js 26 Is Now LTS: A SaaS Production Upgrade Plan - DEV Community (https://dev.to/somnath_khadanga_2e5c2364/nodejs-26-is-now-lts-a-saas-production-upgrade-plan-271l)
Node.js 26 Becomes LTS on 28 October 2026: Which Node Version to Use Now, and How the New Yearly Release Schedule Works (https://www.vilvaathiban.com/blog/nodejs-26-lts-october-2026-which-node-version-to-use-new-release-schedule)
Node.js LTS Versions: Which One to Run in Production (https://seahawkmedia.com/nodejs/nodejs-lts-versions/)
Node.js 26 LTS upgrade: Temporal, V8 14.6 and removed APIs (https://fireup.pro/news/nodejs-26-lts-whats-new-upgrade)
Node.js latest version (2026): 26.13.1 LTS & end-of-life dates (https://latestat.com/nodejs)
Node.js LTS in 2026: Easy Guide to Node 24 vs Node 26 (https://www.techbellasolutions.com/blogs/node-js-lts-version-guide/)
Node.js 26 LTS: What's New and How to Upgrade (https://www.coderzap.com/articles/nodejs-26-lts-whats-new)
Node.js 26 LTS on October 28: which version to run? (https://convika.com/blog/nodejs-26-lts-which-version-to-run/)
Node.js End of Life (EOL) Dates and End of Support (EOS) Dates (https://eosl.date/eol/product/nodejs/)
Node.js 26 ("Lithium") is the current Active LTS line as of late November 2026. Most sources agree on this, though a few older articles still describe it as Current.

- **Status and dates:** Several sources say Node.js 26 became a Long Term Support release on October 28, 2026, and that it is supported through April 30, 2029.
- **Patch level:** The latest patch I found is 26.13.1, from a security release on November 11, 2026 (the current Node.js version is 26.13.1, released Nov 11, 2026). Another source notes that 26.13.0 was the first LTS release.
- **Other lines:** Node.js 24 is in Maintenance LTS, with April 30, 2028 as its end-of-life date. Node.js 22 is also in Maintenance LTS and reaches end of life on April 30, 2027. Node.js 20 has already reached end of life.
- **Discrepancy:** Sources differ on when Node 26 moves to Maintenance. One gives Active support until Oct 27, 2027, while another says it moves from Active LTS to Maintenance on October 20, 2027.
- **Older articles:** Some pre-October pieces still call Node 26 Current, such as one stating that Node.js 26 is still a Current release. These predate the promotion.
